032
033public class CargoScan extends BaseCommandPlugin {
034
035        public static String PODS_FOUND = "$scan_podsFound";
036        public static String CONTRABAND_FOUND = "$scan_contrabandFound";
037        public static String SUSPICOUS_CARGO_FOUND = "$scan_suspiciousCargoFound";
038        //public static String DEMAND_BOARDING = "$scan_demandBoarding";
039        public static String RESULT_KEY = "$scan_cargoScanResult";
040        
041        public static float INSPECTION_DAMAGE_MULT = 0.2f;
042        public static float CHANCE_TO_FIND_ILLEGAL_MULT = 2f;
043        
044        public static class CargoScanResult {
045                protected CargoAPI legalFound, illegalFound;
046                public CargoAPI getLegalFound() {
047                        return legalFound;
048                }
049                public void setLegalFound(CargoAPI legalFound) {
050                        this.legalFound = legalFound;
051                }
052                public CargoAPI getIllegalFound() {
053                        return illegalFound;
054                }
055                public void setIllegalFound(CargoAPI illegalFound) {
056                        this.illegalFound = illegalFound;
057                }
058                
059                protected List<FleetMemberAPI> shipsToDamage = new ArrayList<FleetMemberAPI>();
060        }
061        
062        
063        public boolean execute(String ruleId, InteractionDialogAPI dialog, List<Token> params, Map<String, MemoryAPI> memoryMap) {
064                if (dialog == null) return false;
065                if (!(dialog.getInteractionTarget() instanceof CampaignFleetAPI)) return false;
066                
067                CampaignFleetAPI playerFleet = Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet();
068                CampaignFleetAPI other = (CampaignFleetAPI) dialog.getInteractionTarget();
069                
070                FactionAPI faction = other.getFaction();
071                
072                CargoScanResult result = new CargoScanResult();
073                
074                float totalLegal = 0;
075                float totalLegalCargo = 0;
076                float totalIllegal = 0;
077                float totalIllegalFound = 0;
078                CargoAPI legalFound = Global.getFactory().createCargo(true); 
079                CargoAPI illegalFound = Global.getFactory().createCargo(true);
080                CargoAPI all = Global.getFactory().createCargo(true);
081                
082                float totalCargo = playerFleet.getCargo().getSpaceUsed();
083                float totalCrew = playerFleet.getCargo().getTotalPersonnel();
084                float totalFuel = playerFleet.getCargo().getFuel();
085                
086                for (CargoStackAPI stack : playerFleet.getCargo().getStacksCopy()) {
087                        boolean legal = !faction.isIllegal(stack);
088                        if (legal) {
089                                totalLegal += stack.getSize();
090                                totalLegalCargo += stack.getCargoSpace();
091                        } else {
092                                totalIllegal += stack.getSize();
093                        }
094                        all.addFromStack(stack);
095                }
096                //float guiltMult = InvestigationEvent.getPlayerRepGuiltMult(faction);
097                float guiltMult = 1f;
098                
099                float shieldedFraction = Misc.getShieldedCargoFraction(playerFleet);
100                float unshieldedFraction = 1f - shieldedFraction;
101                
102                float shieldedMult = (0.25f + 0.75f * unshieldedFraction);
103                
104                MarketAPI market = Misc.getSourceMarket(other);
105                float level = market == null ? 0 : market.getMemory().getFloat(MemFlags.MEMORY_MARKET_SMUGGLING_SUSPICION_LEVEL);
106                float suspicionMult = 0f;
107                if (market != null) {
108                        if (level >= 0.05f) {
109                                suspicionMult = 0.5f + 0.5f * level;
110                        }
111                }
112                
113                totalLegalCargo *= shieldedMult;
114                
115                
116                boolean suspicious = false;
117                boolean suspiciousDueToLevel = false;
118                if (totalLegalCargo > 50 || totalLegalCargo > playerFleet.getCargo().getMaxCapacity() * 0.5f) {
119                        totalLegalCargo *= suspicionMult;
120                        suspicious = totalLegalCargo * guiltMult * (float) Math.random() > 
121                                                                playerFleet.getCargo().getMaxCapacity() * (float) Math.random();
122                }
123                
124//              suspicious = false;
125//              level = 10f;
126                
127                if (!suspicious && level >= 0.5f) {
128                        float r = (float) Math.random();
129                        suspicious |= r * r < level;
130                        if (suspicious) {
131                                suspiciousDueToLevel = true;
132                        }
133                }
134                
135                if (totalLegal + totalIllegal > 0) {
136                        List<CargoStackAPI> stacks = all.getStacksCopy();
137                        Collections.shuffle(stacks);
138                        //float illegalSoFar = 0;
139                        float illegalCargoSoFar = 0;
140                        float illegalCrewSoFar = 0;
141                        float illegalFuelSoFar = 0;
142                        for (CargoStackAPI stack : stacks) {
143                                if (stack.getSize() <= 0) continue;
144                                boolean legal = !faction.isIllegal(stack);
145                                float chanceToFind = 0f;
146                                if (stack.isPersonnelStack()) {
147                                        if (totalCrew > 0) {
148                                                if (!legal) illegalCrewSoFar += stack.getSize();
149                                                chanceToFind = illegalCrewSoFar / totalCrew;
150                                        }
151                                } else if (stack.isFuelStack()) {
152                                        if (totalFuel > 0) {
153                                                if (!legal) illegalFuelSoFar += stack.getSize();
154                                                chanceToFind = illegalFuelSoFar / totalFuel;
155                                        }
156                                } else {
157                                        if (totalCargo > 0) {
158                                                if (!legal) illegalCargoSoFar += stack.getCargoSpace();
159                                                chanceToFind = illegalCargoSoFar / totalCargo;
160                                        }
161                                }
162                                
163                                chanceToFind *= guiltMult;
164                                chanceToFind *= shieldedMult;
165                                chanceToFind *= CHANCE_TO_FIND_ILLEGAL_MULT;
166                                chanceToFind *= Misc.isExtended() ? Global.getSettings().getFloat("ext_cargoScanFindContrabandMult") : 1f;
167                                
168//                              if (chanceToFind > 0 && !legal) {
169//                                      System.out.println("fwefwef");
170//                              }
171                                if (legal) {
172                                        legalFound.addFromStack(stack);
173                                } else if ((float) Math.random() < chanceToFind) {
174                                        float qty = stack.getSize();
175                                        qty = qty * (0.33f + (float) Math.random() * 0.67f);
176                                        qty *= shieldedMult;
177                                        qty = Math.round(qty);
178                                        if (qty < 1) qty = 1;
179                                        illegalFound.addItems(stack.getType(), stack.getData(), qty);
180                                }
181                        }
182                }
183                //illegalFound.clear();
184                
185                //boolean boarding = !suspicious && level >= 0.5f && illegalFound.isEmpty();
186                if (suspicious && illegalFound.isEmpty()) {
187                        WeightedRandomPicker<FleetMemberAPI> picker = new WeightedRandomPicker<FleetMemberAPI>();
188                        for (FleetMemberAPI member : playerFleet.getFleetData().getMembersListCopy()) {
189                                if (member.isMothballed() && member.getRepairTracker().getBaseCR() < 0.2f) continue;
190                                picker.add(member, member.getFleetPointCost());
191                        }
192                        if (picker.isEmpty()) {
193                                suspicious = false;
194                        } else {
195                                float totalDamage = Math.min(playerFleet.getFleetPoints(), other.getFleetPoints()) * INSPECTION_DAMAGE_MULT;
196                                if (Misc.isExtended()) {
197                                        totalDamage *= Global.getSettings().getFloat("ext_cargoScanNumShipsMult");
198                                }
199                                float picked = 0f;
200                                while (picked < totalDamage && !picker.isEmpty()) {
201                                        FleetMemberAPI pick = picker.pickAndRemove();
202                                        result.shipsToDamage.add(pick);
203                                        picked += pick.getFleetPointCost();
204                                }
205                                
206//                              if (Misc.isExtended()) {
207//                                      float supplies = playerFleet.getCargo().getSupplies();
208//                                      float fuel = playerFleet.getCargo().getFuel();
209//                                      illegalFound.addCommodity(Commodities.SUPPLIES, ((int) Math.min(supplies * 0.1f, 100f)));
210//                                      illegalFound.addCommodity(Commodities.FUEL, ((int) Math.min(fuel * 0.1f, 200f)));
211//                              }
212                        }
213                }
214                
215                result.setLegalFound(legalFound);
216                result.setIllegalFound(illegalFound);
217                
218                MemoryAPI memory = memoryMap.get(MemKeys.LOCAL);
219                memory.set(CONTRABAND_FOUND, !illegalFound.isEmpty(), 0);
220                memory.set(SUSPICOUS_CARGO_FOUND, suspicious, 0);
221                memory.set(RESULT_KEY, result, 0);
222                
223                float maxPodsDist = 1500f;
224                OUTER: for (SectorEntityToken entity : other.getContainingLocation().getAllEntities()) {
225                        if (Entities.CARGO_PODS.equals(entity.getCustomEntityType())) {
226                                VisibilityLevel vLevel = entity.getVisibilityLevelTo(other);
227                                if (entity.getCustomPlugin() instanceof CargoPodsEntityPlugin) {
228                                        float dist = Misc.getDistance(playerFleet, entity);
229                                        if (dist > maxPodsDist) continue;
230                                        
231                                        CargoPodsEntityPlugin plugin = (CargoPodsEntityPlugin) entity.getCustomPlugin();
232                                        if (plugin.getElapsed() <= 1f && entity.getCargo() != null) {
233                                                if (vLevel == VisibilityLevel.COMPOSITION_DETAILS ||
234                                                                vLevel == VisibilityLevel.COMPOSITION_AND_FACTION_DETAILS) {
235                                                        for (CargoStackAPI stack : entity.getCargo().getStacksCopy()) {
236                                                                boolean legal = !faction.isIllegal(stack);
237                                                                if (!legal) {
238                                                                        memory.set(PODS_FOUND, true, 0);
239                                                                        Misc.fadeAndExpire(entity);
240                                                                        break OUTER;                                                                    
241                                                                }
242                                                        }
243
244                                                }
245                                        }
246                                }
247                        }
248                }
249                
250                TextPanelAPI text = dialog.getTextPanel();
251                
252                //text.setFontVictor();
253                text.setFontSmallInsignia();
254                
255                Color hl = Misc.getHighlightColor();
256                Color red = Misc.getNegativeHighlightColor();
257                text.addParagraph("-----------------------------------------------------------------------------");
258                
259                if (!illegalFound.isEmpty()) {
260                        text.addParagraph("Contraband found!", red);
261                        String para = "";
262                        List<String> highlights = new ArrayList<String>();
263                        for (CargoStackAPI stack : illegalFound.getStacksCopy()) {
264                                para += stack.getDisplayName() + " " + Strings.X + " " + (int)stack.getSize() + "\n";
265                                highlights.add("" + (int)stack.getSize());
266                        }
267                        para = para.substring(0, para.length() - 1);
268                        text.addParagraph(para);
269                        text.highlightInLastPara(hl, highlights.toArray(new String [0]));
270                } else if (suspicious) {
271                        if (suspiciousDueToLevel) {
272                                text.addParagraph("Vessels flagged for inspection due to overall suspicion level!", hl);
273                        } else {
274                                text.addParagraph("Suspicious cargo found!", hl);
275                        }
276                } else {
277                        text.addParagraph("No contraband or suspicious cargo found.");
278                }
279                
280                text.addParagraph("-----------------------------------------------------------------------------");
281                
282                text.setFontInsignia();
283                
284                for (CargoStackAPI stack : illegalFound.getStacksCopy()) {
285                        totalIllegalFound += stack.getSize();
286                }
287                
288                float capacity = playerFleet.getCargo().getMaxCapacity();
289                float repLoss = totalIllegalFound / 5f * totalIllegalFound / capacity;
290                repLoss = Math.round(repLoss);
291                if (repLoss > 5) repLoss = 5f;
292                if (repLoss == 0 && totalIllegalFound > 0) repLoss = 1f;
293                if (suspicious) {
294                        repLoss = 5f;
295                }
296                if (repLoss > 0) {
297                        RepActionEnvelope envelope = new RepActionEnvelope(RepActions.CUSTOMS_CAUGHT_SMUGGLING, repLoss, dialog.getTextPanel());
298                        Global.getSector().adjustPlayerReputation(envelope, faction.getId());
299                        
300                        envelope = new RepActionEnvelope(RepActions.CUSTOMS_CAUGHT_SMUGGLING, repLoss * 2f, dialog.getTextPanel());
301                        Global.getSector().adjustPlayerReputation(envelope, dialog.getInteractionTarget().getActivePerson());
302                }
303                
304                return true;
305        }
306
307}
